title: Mermail Bounty Ops
lines: No auto-pay • No auto-send • No secret handling
narration: This is Mermail Bounty Ops, a reusable Agent Skill that turns paid-opportunity emails into safe work packets before an agent spends money, signs a wallet, or sends anything.

title: 1. Bounded Mermail workflow
lines: save_draft only when a reply is useful
narration: The workflow composes the existing Mermail tools. It resolves one mailbox, searches a bounded candidate set, reads only selected messages, and can save an unsent clarification draft. A reply remains an external effect that needs exact user approval.

title: 2. Three opportunity emails
lines: FIXED: 150 USDC after accepted QA report
PRIZE: 500 USDC total prizes for an Agent Skill
RISKY: '1,000 USDC guaranteed' + 20 USDC deposit + seed request
narration: The demo uses three sanitized fixtures: fixed compensation for an accepted QA report, a competitive five-hundred USDC prize pool, and a high-risk message that promises guaranteed payment but asks for a deposit and a seed phrase.

title: 3. Deterministic classification
lines: fixed-work       → zero-stated cost → manual platform submit
competitive-prize → payout NOT guaranteed → manual submit
flags: advance payment • secret request • prompt injection
narration: The result preserves the commercial distinction. Fixed work stays conditional on acceptance. A prize pool is never presented as guaranteed income. The unsafe message is blocked because it requests advance payment, secret material, and contains prompt injection.

title: 4. Regression test
lines: must NOT become a spend or signing risk.
narration: The demo also caught a false positive during development. A sentence saying no deposit and no wallet signature are required was initially misclassified. The parser was fixed, and a regression test now protects that negated safety clause.

title: 5. Install and inspect
narration: The repository includes the skill, tool and security references, deterministic fixtures, the demo runner, and tests. Install the skill, connect Mermail MCP, and replace the fixtures with selected agent-safe email reads. The offline demo executes no writes and no payments.
